text: At e<=0.9 the force margin fails the bar in seed 71 (0.084), and headroom-normalised force falls to 0.09-0.17, against 0.16-0.22 at e<=0.75. Across e ceilings of 0.5-0.9 for seeds 70-72, is the ratio of normalised force margin to normalised accel_step margin constant? If so, force decodability would be tracking accel_step decodability rather than declining on its own.
